Best Windows Laptops for 4K Video Editing & Graphic Design (100% sRGB & OLED)

Most gaming laptops under ₹70,000 ship with cheap 45% NTSC displays that look dull and inaccurate for color grading. You need at least 100% sRGB or 100% DCI-P3 coverage.

🎯 Quick Buyer Verdict

For pure color reproduction, the ASUS Vivobook Pro 15 OLED (2.8K 120Hz 100% DCI-P3) is magic. For high-powered 3D Blender and 4K export speeds, the Predator Helios Neo 16 (500 nits) is exceptional.
